title: Get Claude Code for free forever with OmniRoute! 🚀
description:
OmniRoute changes the game by letting users run Claude Code through a single gateway connected to over 230 providers. This setup bypasses complex configuration by offering auto-fallback features, meaning access to powerful AI coding agents remains free and incredibly simple to implement. Whether working within Agent OS or other environments, developers can now streamline their workflow without the typical setup headaches.
